description: Traversal helpers over the nested document structure (sections → columns → blocks, recursing into hero, group and wrapper containers) plus identifier reassignment used by clone-with-new-ids.

members.name: AllBlockLists
members.description: Enumerates every block list (a column's or a hero's Blocks) in the document.

members.name: AllBlocks
members.description: Enumerates every block anywhere in the document.

members.name: AllColumns
members.description: Enumerates every column anywhere in the document, recursing into all containers.

members.name: AllSections
members.description: Enumerates every section, including those nested inside wrapper blocks.

members.name: ReassignIds
members.description: Assigns a fresh identifier to a block and to every node nested beneath it.
